slides.title: Monday: meet the team
slides.text: Shadow the Harbor Supply Co. account call and read the last three weekly reports.

slides.title: Tuesday: tools
slides.text: Get access to Pulse Analytics and Orbit CRM. Build one dashboard view of your own.

slides.title: Wednesday: your first audit
slides.text: Review one live campaign against the launch checklist and list what you would change.

slides.title: Friday: present
slides.text: Walk your lead through the audit in ten minutes. **Two clear recommendations beat ten small ones.**
